Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this match. It's a quick turnaround as the third T20I is on 23rd September (Friday) at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT) and we are looking forward to your company. Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, is also the Player of the Match for his 110* off 66 balls. Says that the discussion in the dressing room during the break was to believe in themselves as this target is chasable and they have done it in the past. Feels that under lights, the pitch becomes better for batting. Calls it a proper T20 surface and admits that they gave away a few extra runs. Praises the knock of Mohammad Rizwan. Regarding his batting, Rizwan smiles and adds that he believed in himself and the teammates supported him when the runs were not coming.

Moeen Ali, the English skipper, says that it was a very good score but the wicket was a brilliant one and didn't assist the bowlers in the second half. Talks about the dropped catch and he admits that his own over, where he conceded 21 runs, shifted the momentum completely. Praises the stand between Ben Duckett and Philip Salt and he is pleased with the way England batted. Shares that it's hard to read the pitch and credits the knocks of Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

The pitch played brilliantly in this match. England enjoyed their time and at the halfway mark, it appeared that they have got enough but the lack of wickets and failure to get a chance to put the Pakistan middle order to test cost the visiting team. This is just the start of the series and with Pakistan bouncing back, we are in for a cracker.

England were outplayed with the ball. They were pretty much flat throughout and struggled to break the opening stand. Mohammad Rizwan did offer them a few chances - on 23 (dropped by Alex Hales), 32 (stumping missed) and 83 (dropped by Moeen Ali) but England didn't take any and from thereon, it was one-way traffic. Babar Azam was a bit slow off the blocks but once he got into his groove, we were treated to some incredible strokeplay from him. Babar roared back to form with a stupendous century and the spectators had a ball cheering for him.

Extraordinary chase from Pakistan. They scaled down a big target without much discomfort and have brought this 7-match series on level terms, 1-1. In terms of getting answers to their shortcomings, the hosts didn't gain much as the middle order was not tested at all while the other department of their game was quite below par on the field. Still, it's a win to lift the confidence of the team, and they will hope to get things fixed in other areas.
FOUR! AZAM ENDS IT IN STYLE! Fuller and on off, Babar Azam leans forward and crunches it through extra cover for the winning runs. PAKISTAN WIN BY 10 WICKETS!
Rizwan takes a few steps ahead. This is a yorker on middle, it is jammed out to mid on for one.
On middle, this is worked on the leg side for one.
Two! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of the fielder at mid-wicket for two. 3 needed more.
WIDE! Down the leg side, yet another wide. Rizwan tries to flick but misses.
Dropped! Tough chance but needed to be taken! Full and outside off. This is lofted towards cover. Moeen Ali leaps, it hits the hand but does not stay in. Two.
WIDE! Another wide as this is also bowled well WIDE outside off.
WIDE! JUST 9 NEEDED! Well wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! OVER THE BOWLER! Fuller and outside off, this is hit over the bowler and down to the long off fence.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
FOUR! THERE IS THE BOUNDARY TO EASE THE NERVES! Full and on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A full toss, this is hit down to long on for one.
Around off, on a length, Rizwan heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a run. A terrific over by Sam Curran. 20 needed off 12 balls. England can still bounce back if they pick a wicket or two immediately.

HUNDRED FOR BABAR AZAM! The crowd erupts. His second T20I hundred and Babar has roared back to form after the disappointment of the Asia Cup. He reaches there by tapping a length ball on the off side for a run. 21 needed off 13 balls.
A length delivery outside off, Rizwan takes it from there and sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Fullish and outside off, Babar eases it down to long off and picks up a single. Moves to 99!
Another swing and a miss! Back of a length, around off, Babar goes back to pull but gets a thin edge behind. It doesn't carry to the keeper.
Short and wide outside off, Babar flashes his bat at it but fails to connect.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one. 24 needed off 18 balls.
SIX! BANG! The little pressure that was building has been let off with that full toss. Azam heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder leaps but parries it over the fence.
On middle, Rizwan works it through mid-wicket for one.
Rizwan shapes up early to play the sweep, it is bowled wide of the off pole. Rizwan still manages to hit it wide of square leg for two.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A full toss, this is hit through square leg for one. Rizwan misses out there.
David Willey is back on. 36 needed off 24 balls.
FOUR! Yet again the boundary off the last ball! On middle, this is whipped wide of long on for a boundary.
A full one on middle, this is jammed out to mid off for a run.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Brilliant placement, brilliant running! On middle, this is worked wide of long on for two.
Good pace! Length and on off, this angles away. Azam is beaten as he tries to push at it.
FOUR! PAKISTAN RACING ALONG! Short and outside off, this is slapped through point for a boundary.
WIDE! This is well wide outside off, left alone.
Luke Wood returns to bowl his third over. 0 for 19 so far.
Fuller and around off, driven to extra cover for one. 49 needed from the last 30 balls.
SIX! Dispatched! Perhaps a googly, landing full around middle, Babar picks it and goes down to send it flying over deep square leg. Pakistan are marching towards the target, 50 needed more.
Bowls it flat and short on middle, Babar eases it down to wide long on for two.
Swing and a miss! Short and outside off, Azam tries to punch but misses.
Fuller and quicker on middle, it's knocked down to long on for one.
SIX! Flighted and full, landing around off, Mohammad Rizwan kneels down and smokes it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Adil Rashid is back on.
FOUR! WHIPPED AWAY! The last ball spoils the over! On the pads, this is worked past short fine leg and into the fence.
Shorter and outside off, Rizwan under edges it towards the off side for one more. Can Curran end the over well now?
Brilliant running! On middle, this is worked with soft hands on the leg side for one.
Just the three runs from three balls! On middle, this is pulled to long on for one more.
A slower one, this stays low. Rizwan looks to pull, it goes off the inside edge on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
Sam Curran is brought back into the attack. 0 for 15 in his 2 overs. Can he provide the breakthrough?

SIX! THREE IN THE OVER! Just the kind Pakistan needed. Momentum has completely shifted. On middle, the slog-sweep is out and it sails over the mid-wicket fence. 21 off the over, 75 needed off 42 balls.
Sensible batting! On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
SIX! Massive! Second of the over! On off, this is lofted over long on for a biggie.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed down to long on for one.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Azam digs it out down to long on for a run.
SIX! First ball from Moeen is dismissed. Short and around off, turning in, Babar moves back inside the crease and hammer-pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum.

Flatter and on middle, eased down to wide long on for one. Fifty for Babar Azam, a bit on the slower side than Rizwan but he has played his part. Also, this was a great over from Dawson. 96 needed off 48 balls.
Loopy and full around middle, Rizwan helps it to mid-wicket and calls for two. Dawson runs across to his right and keeps the batters down to only one run.
Flatter around leg, pushed down to long on for one. A good over so far by Liam.
Slightly short and on off, Rizwan moves back and turns it to deep mid-wicket for another run.
Fuller and on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single. 100 up, 100 needed more!
Flighted and outside off, Babar tries to force it through the line but misses.
Short again from Wood, around off, Babar pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shortish and on off, hit across the line to deep mid-wicket for two.
Short and outside off, Babar tries to play late but misses.
SIX! Fuller in length around off, slower in pace, Babar shows the full face of his bat and lofts it nonchalantly over long on for a biggie.
Slightly short and outside off, Rizwan punches with an angled bat but finds the point fielder. They cross.
A dipping yorker around off, Rizwan works it from the bottom half of his bat to deep mid-wicket. He takes a couple of runs and brings up his fifty, off just 30 balls.

Drinks break. It's a strong reply from Pakistan in the chase. They are motoring at the moment with both Babar and Rizwan looking in ominous touch. England need wickets to come back into this match. Can they bounce back? Luke Wood to bowl after the break.

Floated and full, outside off, Rizwan goes down to give it a bit of a hack but it takes the top half of his blade. The ball runs down to long on and they cross. At the halfway mark, Pakistan are 87/0. 113 needed more.
Short again, outside off, this time it's cracked to deep point for one.
Short in length and outside off, Babar goes on the back foot and punches but finds Moeen at covers.
Fires it flat around leg, Rizwan goes back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short and on off, Babar moves back and wrists it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and fuller on off, pushed to covers.
Liam Dawson is back on. 0 for 17 in 2 overs so far.
Risky single! Loopy and full around off, Babar pushes it gently to covers and rushes across for a run. Moeen Ali has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Quicker and on middle, eased down to long on for a run.
A flipper, outside off and going straight on, Babar gets back and hits it to cover-point for one.
Fetches a low full toss from outside off and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Uses his feet and knocks a full ball down to long on for a run.
FOUR! That's a great shot! Rashid is on the shorter side with his length, outside off, Babar camps back and punches it through extra cover for a cracking boundary.
A touch short and on middle, Rizwan pulls it through backward square leg and hustles back for the second run.
Short and wide outside off, slower in pace, Rizwan tries to cut but gets a bottom edge. It goes rolling towards the keeper.
Lands it on a length around off, Babar forces it off his back foot to long on for a run.
Shortish and around middle, Babar mistimes his pull shot and it rolls through mid-wicket. They collect two runs.
Very full and around off, Babar drives it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length, around leg, Rizwan tickles it through square leg for a single.
Change. Sam Curran is back for his second over.
Another sweep shot from Rizwan, towards backward square leg but the man in the deep has moved finer now. Only a run.
FOUR! Middled this time. Full and flighted, around leg, Mohammad Rizwan kneels and sweeps it firmly behind square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor line and it's punished. Skidding down the leg side, Rizwan goes down to sweep and it races away off the gloves to the fine leg fence.
Beaten! Floated and full, around off, Rizwan tries to play straight but it spins away a hint to beat the outside edge.
Flatter and shorter around leg, Rizwan gets back to pull but gets hit on the back leg.
Stumping chance missed! Fuller and around off, Mohammad Rizwan steps down the track but fails to work it on the leg side. Philip Salt fails to collect and Rizwan survives.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
13 from the over. Quicker and on off, punched to covers. At the end of the Powerplay, Pakistan are roaring at 59 for no loss. 141 needed off 84 balls.
FOUR! Fine shot! Dawson drops it short and on middle, Babar Azam turns inside the crease and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller around leg, swept to deep square leg for a run.
SIX! No stopping this one! Mohammad Rizwan again uses his feet to reach the pitch of the ball and dispatches it over long on for a maximum. 50 up!

PUT DOWN! Not the first catch to go down this evening. Flighted and around middle, Mohammad Rizwan steps down for an inside-out shot over extra cover but it takes the bottom half of the blade and flies behind mid off. Alex Hales backtracks but fails to catch it over his head. They take two runs.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Rizwan goes down to sweep but perhaps gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Liam Dawson to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
A low full toss on leg, Rizwan misses out as he gets only a run from this freebie by flicking it to deep square leg.
On the pads, it's worked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat. Short in length and outside off, Babar Azam steps back and tries to slap it over covers but ends up slicing it behind backward point for a boundary.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Dismissed! A length ball is delivered around leg, Mohammad Rizwan aligns himself, bends his back knee and muscles it over backward square leg for a maximum. He loves playing this shot.
Back of a length, around leg, Babar stays back to heave but it takes the inner edge and rolls behind square leg for a run.
David Willey is back on after his 12-run first over.

Risky single! Shortish and around off, Azam goes back to pull but only manages to drag it in the direction of mid on. The fielder from mid-wicket intervenes with a slide, picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single is completed.
Fuller in length and on middle, Babar flicks off his pads but finds the fielder inside the ring at mid-wicket.
Around off, on a length at 140 kph, Babar defends it back to the bowler.
Play and a miss! Identical to the last delivery, leaving the batter with the angle outside off, Babar rocks back and tries to punch but misses on this occasion.
FOUR! That's hammered! Width there outside off, short in length, Babar reaches out for it and whacks it through cover-point for a powerful boundary.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, on a shortish length, Babar allows it through.
Serves a length ball around leg, Rizwan works it wide of short fine leg and takes a single.
Luke Wood comes into the attack.
FOUR! Shot! Slower one from Sam, full and around off, Babar Azam picks it very early and powers it behind the bowler for a boundary at long on.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler. Curran had a shy at the striker's end but missed.

FOUR! Smashed! A touch short and on off, angling away, Babar camps back and smacks it towards wide mid on. The fielder dives from inside the ring, and gets his right hand on it as well but still, it deflects away and races away to the fence.
Straighter in line, on a length, Babar turns it on the leg side but finds short mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Babar punches but finds the fielder at covers. Moeen gathers it on one bounce.
Short in length and wide outside off, Rizwan reaches out and forces it through cover-point. There is a sweeper in place and hence only a run.
Change in bowling. Sam Curran to have a go now.
Quick through the air, full and around leg, Rizwan clips it in front of square leg for one. A tidy start from Liam Dawson.
Fires it flat and short around middle, Babar gets back and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on middle, pushed past the bowler to mid on.
Liam goes a bit short and on off, Babar moves back and pushes it to covers where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Quicker and around leg, Rizwan nudges it in front of square on the leg side and rotates the strike.
Flatter and on middle, Babar punches it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Liam Dawson to bowl from the other end.
Serves it on a good length around leg, Babar glances it to deep square leg and opens his account with a single. 12 from the first over, a good start for the home team.
Willey goes short and around leg, Rizwan is a fraction late into his pull shot and mistimes it behind square leg. They cross for a run.
FOUR! Timing and placement! Full in length and around off, shaping in, Rizwan uses his wrists well and flicks it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket. Lovely shot.
Delivers it on a length and around middle, Rizwan doesn't get the room and keeps it out to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely played, using the pace of the bowler. Back of a length, around off and angling away, Mohammad Rizwan rocks back and packs a punch through cover-point.
Off the mark with two runs. Full and on middle, Rizwan tickles it past mid-wicket and returns for the second run.
